market_summary: Across all six asset classes during the London session, price action is heavily compressed within daily Value Areas and mid-channel ATR envelopes. FX pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD) are pinned directly to their session VWAPs and EMA baselines with low RVOL (<1.0) and negligible cumulative delta momentum. Precious metals (XAUUSD, XAGUSD) and US100 are trading below declining session VWAPs but are constrained near their respective Points of Control (POC), lacking institutional volume expansion to drive a breakout. BTCUSD is drifting in a low-volume counter-trend bounce beneath structural EMA50 and VWAP resistance. All symbols remain on disciplined HOLD awaiting NY liquidity expansion.
